name: VR---Moving
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on moving average systems, opening positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when crossover or displacement signals are detected. It manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels, and includes trailing stop functionality to protect profits. The EA operates systematically across multiple timeframes with customizable moving average parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个基于移动平均线系统的趋势跟踪策略，当检测到交叉或位移信号时沿主趋势方向开仓。它通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理仓位，并包含移动止损功能以保护利润。该EA可在多个时间周期上系统化运行，具有可自定义的移动平均线参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于移动平均线的趋势跟踪，通过快速均线与慢速均线的交叉或价格与均线的位移关系来判断趋势方向。入场条件为当快速均线穿越慢速均线向上时做多，向下穿越时做空，或者当价格突破移动均线时顺势入场。出场条件包括触及止损或止盈水平，以及均线的反向交叉信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式，允许用户调整每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制，但部分版本可能缺乏动态风险调整。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号导致频繁亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on moving average systems, determining trend direction through crossover of fast and slow moving averages or displacement relationships between price and the moving average. Entry conditions trigger long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and short positions on the reverse crossover, or when price breaks through the moving average in the trend direction. Exit conditions include hitting stop loss or take profit levels, as well as reverse crossover signals from the moving averages. Position sizing employs fixed lots or account balance percentage-based calculation, allowing users to adjust risk exposure per trade. Money management provides maximum position limits and position reduction after consecutive losses, though some versions may lack dynamic risk adjustment. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for strongly trending markets, but may generate numerous false signals leading to frequent losses in ranging or choppy market conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number，for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典的移动平均线交叉系统，易于理解和验证
具有完整的止损止盈和移动止损机制，能有效控制单笔交易风险
参数可配置性强，用户可以根据不同市场环境灵活调整均线周期和风险参数
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, based on the classic moving average crossover system, easy to understand and verify
Has complete stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop mechanisms to effectively control per-trade risk
Highly configurable parameters allow users to flexibly adjust MA periods and risk settings for different market conditions
cons: 在震荡市场中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏多时间周期确认和趋势强度过滤机制，容易在弱趋势中入场
未包含点差过滤和新闻事件过滤，在市场流动性差时可能不利
cons_en: Prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and trend strength filtering, making it easy to enter during weak trends
Does not include spread filtering or news event filtering, which may be disadvantageous during poor market liquidity
improvements: 增加多时间周期趋势确认机制，如H4趋势方向与H1信号一致性过滤
添加ADX或ATR指标作为趋势强度和波动率过滤器，减少震荡市的虚假信号
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险管理更适应市场波动变化
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation mechanism, such as H4 trend direction alignment with H1 signal filtering
Add ADX or ATR indicators as trend strength and volatility filters to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to make risk management more adaptive to market volatility changes

risk_points: 震荡市场中均线交叉频繁产生虚假信号，可能导致连续止损
缺乏最大回撤控制和每日最大亏损限制，极端行情下风险敞口较大
固定止损可能在低波动率时过大、高波动率时过小，不够灵活
risk_points_en: Frequent MA crossover false signals in ranging markets may cause consecutive stop losses
Lacks maximum drawdown control and daily maximum loss limits, creating large risk exposure during extreme market conditions
Fixed stop loss may be too wide during low volatility and too tight during high volatility, lacking flexibility

The EA operates systematically across multiple timeframes with customizable moving average parameters.
